environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in vpc-0a3f2c (prod-directory-sync) with task role arn:aws:iam::441199223344:role/DirectorySyncTaskRole-Scoped. Service exposed via internal ALB on port 8080. LDAP server is OpenLDAP 2.4.57 at directory.internal:389. The task role has DynamoDB PutItem/GetItem on table 'UserMetadata' with IAM policy condition keys: dynamodb:LeadingKeys restricts access to items where partition key matches ${aws:PrincipalTag/department}, and dynamodb:Attributes condition limits writable attributes to ['uid','cn','mail','department']. Additionally, a DynamoDB resource policy with condition aws:SourceVpce restricts table access to vpce-0x44fa2b only. The ALB target group has a listener rule that routes /api/v1/directory/lookup only when the X-Internal-Service-Mesh header matches a rotating HMAC token issued by the service mesh control plane (Consul Connect with mTLS intentions). Security group sg-0bf4a allows inbound 8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. No WAF is attached to the ALB.

config.dynamodb_policy: Allow PutItem/GetItem on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:441199223344:table/UserMetadata WITH Condition: ForAllValues:StringEquals dynamodb:LeadingKeys ['${aws:PrincipalTag/department}'] AND Condition: ForAllValues:StringEquals dynamodb:Attributes ['uid','cn','mail','department'] with Effect Deny on non-matching
config.dynamodb_resource_policy: Deny all actions unless aws:SourceVpce equals vpce-0x44fa2b
config.service_mesh: Consul Connect with mTLS intentions; only registered sidecar proxies with valid SPIFFE identity spiffe://corp.internal/ns/prod/dc/us-east-1/svc/directory-sync can reach the upstream LDAP service
config.ldap_network_policy: Consul intention: deny all -> directory.internal EXCEPT source identity spiffe://corp.internal/ns/prod/dc/us-east-1/svc/directory-sync with L7 permission restricting LDAP search filter to regex ^\(&\(objectClass=person\)\(uid=[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\)(\(department=[a-zA-Z0-9 ]+\))?\)$
